title: Global food waste
definition: Total food wasted in households, food services and retail globally in a calendar year.

sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
sources.title: Call to Action: Fifth Observance of the International Day of Awareness of Food Loss and Waste (citing UNEP 2024)

points.estimate_method: Global household, food service and retail food waste estimate from UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024 cited by FAO.
points.evidence: Page 5, Global facts and figures: An estimated 1.05 billion tonnes of food were wasted in households, food services and in retail in 2022, the equivalent of 132 kg per capita (UNEP, 2024).
